decisions.reason: As a web-map search module that is very close to the firm's existing GIS integration knowledge, it remains commercially understandable and improvable, though its niche plugin character makes withdrawal somewhat more plausible than for the core platform.

The mobile layer-control component still fits the firm's established geospatial UX and mobile capabilities well, so management would usually retain it, even if changing frontend technologies create some medium exit risk.

The GIS solution platform is tightly aligned with the firm's strategic direction, in-house R&D, and cumulative architectural know-how, making continued support and development the clearly more likely choice.

Mobile field data capture is a strong adjacent application for this firm's geospatial and enterprise integration capabilities, so absorptive capacity favors further refinement rather than withdrawal despite some portfolio rationalization risk.
